press-banca: barbell lowered to touch the lower chest, elbows bent about 45 degrees from the torso
arms fully extended, barbell pressed straight up above the shoulders
press-inclinado-mancuernas: dumbbells lowered beside the upper chest, elbows bent below the bench line
arms extended, dumbbells pressed up above the upper chest
press-pecho-maquina: handles beside the chest, elbows bent and pulled back
arms extended forward, handles pushed away from the chest
aperturas-pec-deck: arms opened wide to the sides at shoulder height, chest stretched
arms brought together in front of the chest, pads almost touching
jalon-pecho: arms fully extended overhead holding the wide bar
bar pulled down to the upper chest, elbows pointing down and back
remo-polea-sentado: arms extended forward holding the handle, back straight, shoulders forward
handle pulled to the abdomen, elbows behind the torso, shoulder blades squeezed
remo-mancuerna: working arm hanging straight down holding the dumbbell
dumbbell pulled up to the hip, elbow bent and pointing back
press-hombro-mancuernas: dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows bent below the hands
arms extended overhead, dumbbells pressed up above the head
elevaciones-laterales: arms down by the sides holding the dumbbells
arms raised out to the sides to shoulder height, slight elbow bend
face-pull: arms extended forward toward the cable holding the rope
rope pulled toward the forehead, elbows high and wide, hands beside the ears
curl-biceps: arms straight down by the sides, palms forward holding the dumbbells
elbows fully bent, dumbbells curled up to the shoulders, elbows still at the sides
curl-martillo: arms straight down by the sides, palms facing the body
elbows fully bent, dumbbells curled up to the shoulders with palms facing each other
triceps-polea: elbows bent about 90 degrees at the sides, bar at chest height
arms fully extended down, bar pushed to the thighs, elbows still at the sides
prensa-piernas: knees bent about 90 degrees, platform lowered toward the chest, lower back flat on the pad
legs extended pushing the platform away, knees almost straight but not locked
extension-cuadriceps: knees bent about 90 degrees, lower legs vertical behind the padded roller
knees extended, legs straight forward lifting the padded roller
curl-femoral: knees almost straight, legs extended forward, lower legs resting on top of the front padded roller at ankle height
knees fully bent about 90 degrees or more, heels pulled down and back under the seat, pushing the padded roller down and back
hip-thrust: hips lowered close to the floor, upper back on the bench, knees bent
hips lifted up so the torso and thighs form a straight line, knees at 90 degrees
peso-muerto-rumano: standing tall, dumbbells in front of the thighs
hips hinged back with a flat back, dumbbells lowered to mid shin, knees slightly bent
sentadilla-goblet-cajon: standing tall holding one dumbbell at the chest in front of a box
squatting down until the hips lightly touch the box behind, thighs about parallel to the floor, chest up
abduccion-cadera: knees pushed apart, legs opened wide against the pads
aduccion-cadera: knees opened wide against the pads
pantorrillas: heels lowered slightly below the step, calves stretched
rising high on the balls of the feet, heels lifted
plancha: kneeling on the mat with forearms down, preparing for the plank
full forearm plank, body straight from head to heels, hips level
pallof-press: handle held against the middle of the chest with both hands
arms extended straight forward pressing the handle away from the chest, torso not rotating
dead-bug: lying on the back, both arms pointing to the ceiling, hips and knees bent at 90 degrees
one arm extended overhead and the opposite leg extended straight just above the floor, lower back flat
bird-dog: on hands and knees, back flat, all four limbs on the mat
one arm extended forward and the opposite leg extended back in a straight line, back flat
remo-maquina: arms extended forward holding the handles, chest on the pad
handles pulled back to the ribs, elbows behind the torso, shoulder blades squeezed
pajaro-inverso: arms extended forward in front of the chest holding the handles
arms opened backward out to the sides at shoulder height, shoulder blades squeezed
extension-cadera-polea: working leg slightly forward under the hip, standing tall
working leg extended straight back at the hip, torso still upright
eliptica: right foot forward and left foot back on the pedals, left arm forward
left foot forward and right foot back on the pedals, right arm forward
movilidad-cadera: standing tall with the dowel along the back touching head, upper back and tailbone
hips hinged back, torso leaning forward with a flat back, dowel still touching head, upper back and tailbone, knees slightly bent
estiramientos: standing tall, both feet on the floor, arms relaxed
one foot held behind toward the glute with the hand, knees together, other arm extended forward for balance
